# Synth Line Normalizer

Call `synth_line_normalizer.run()` with captured text lines before deterministic comparison.

def run(lines: list[str], *, drop_empty: bool = True) -> list[str]:
    """Strip surrounding whitespace and optionally remove empty lines."""
    normalized = [line.strip() for line in lines]
    return [line for line in normalized if line] if drop_empty else normalized
